free_tier_limits: Free public access; no paid plans. No public rate-limit numbers are published.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: CORRECTED. Current official API documentation describes public programmatic access but publishes no pricing tiers or numeric request-rate quota; its documented limits are query controls such as firstNObservations/lastNObservations, not rate limits. Evidence: https://data.ecb.europa.eu/help/api/overview and https://data.ecb.europa.eu/help/api/data
